newsitem.title: UK: Labour 20 points ahead in Telegraph "rolling poll".
newsitem.headline: Labour 20 points ahead in Telegraph "rolling poll".

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party is 20 points ahead of the ruling Conservatives, according to a Gallup survey to be published in the Daily Telegraph on Tuesday, the newspaper said in a statement.
Labour is backed by 53 percent of British voters while the Conservatives have the support of 33 percent and the Liberal Democrats 10 percent, the poll indicated.
The Telegraph is publishing a poll every day until election day on May 1, with Gallup initially interviewing at least 300 people by telephone for each sounding.
Labour's support is unchanged from the 53 percent recorded in Monday's poll -- the first in the series -- but Conservative support has risen to 33 percent from 32 percent.
"The swing towards Labour since the 1992 election now stands at 13.8 percent and the projected Labour majority is 211 (seats in the House of Commons)," the Telegraph said.
